effects.description: [Main] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Red-Haired Pirates} type card other than [Come On!! We'll Fight You!!] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
conditions: You have at least 5 cards in your deck
steps: Rest 1 DON!! card to pay the cost
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck
(Optional) Reveal up to 1 {Red-Haired Pirates} type card from those 5, excluding [Come On!! We'll Fight You!!], and add it to your hand
Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order
notes: You can choose not to add a card to your hand
This effect happens during your Main Phase
The order of the remaining cards can be chosen freely

conditions: This card is revealed from your Life area as a Trigger
steps: (Optional) Reveal this card to your opponent
If you do, draw 1 card from your deck
notes: You can choose whether or not to use this Trigger effect
If you don't want to draw, you can ignore this effect
